candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `if(intitalized)revert();` so SetMinSum can set MinSum even after initialization.
Replace `MinSum = _val;` with `MinSum = 0;` so any SetMinSum call sets MinSum to zero instead of _val.
Delete `require(!locked_);` from the nonReentrant_ modifier so SetMinSum succeeds even when the lock is held (e.g. during a reentrant call from Collect), changing the resulting MinSum.
Delete `locked_ = false;` so the lock is never released, causing every subsequent SetMinSum call to revert and leaving MinSum at its first set value.
Replace `require(!locked_);` with `require(locked_);` so SetMinSum always reverts and MinSum can never be set.
Remove the assignment 'MinSum = _val;' so SetMinSum no longer updates MinSum.
Change the assignment to store '_val + 1' instead of '_val' in MinSum.
Remove the 'if(intitalized)revert();' guard so MinSum can still be updated after initialization.
Delete the assignment `LogFile = Log(_log);` so the stored LogFile address is never set.
Assign a different address (msg.sender) to LogFile instead of the _log argument.
Move the assignment before the `if(intitalized)revert();` check so LogFile is set even when initialized, then the call reverts.
Delete the final `locked_ = false;` statement so the lock is never released, making all subsequent nonReentrant_ calls revert and freezing LogFile after the first SetLogFile call.
